gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-rhodium-libre: Red Hat Display draws every curve with a marker's constant line. It handles bold, contemporary statements, while Rhodium Libre, a text serif, brings the editorial, traditional voice with its lifted brush ends.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-roboto-serif: Roboto Serif reads dignified and classic, with generous eyes on its e and a and letters set well apart. And Red Hat Display, drawn with a fixed-width nib, adds a bold line against stems that outweigh hairlines only slightly.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-rokkitt: Red Hat Display holds its round bowls at a constant width, with daylight showing inside every curve, and Rokkitt sits below it. Their strongest quality is that bookish, traditional text serif against such a bold, marker-like line.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-sahitya: Red Hat Display keeps a steady, marker-like line throughout. Beneath it, Sahitya, a text serif, lets thin strokes run only slightly lighter than the thick ones, so both parts of the page feel open and uncrowded.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-sanchez: Sanchez opens its c like a pair of calipers. Over a long stretch it feels bookish and dignified as a serif, with low contrast that lets Red Hat Display's uniform horizontals and verticals stand out above it.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-sawarabi-minch: Refined and classic, Sawarabi Mincho keeps its terminals cut short of the bowl and its stroke weight easing only slightly. Red Hat Display is the bolder one, with no thick-thin swing at all.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-sedan: Authoritative and bookish, Sedan is the text serif here, with terminals held far from the stroke body. Over a longer passage Red Hat Display's flat, contrast-free letterforms give way to its mellow, gently varying weights.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-sedan-sc: Red Hat Display stays bold and contemporary, its joins as thick as its strokes, with visible daylight in every curve. But Sedan SC leans literary, with broad open counters and the mild thick-thin variation of a letterpress slug.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-shippori-minch: Literary and classic, Shippori Mincho carries modest stress in its curves. Across a longer passage it reads gently, its generous openings softening Red Hat Display's monoweight skeleton above.
Refined and editorial, Shippori Mincho B1 gives a text serif with a wide crescent-wrench c and hairlines of reasonable sturdiness. Red Hat Display, steady as a drawn string, sits above it.
